# Self-medicate Empiric Antibiotics for Fever or Other Signs of Systemic Infectio

Patients should keep an emergency supply of antibiotics on hand to be used

for the development of fever or other signs of systemic infection, and

seek medical care immediately if these symptoms develop.

# Recommendations to self- medicate:

[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875MG PO BID for asplenia empiric antibiotic \($\) R](psozid-amoxicillin-clavulanate-875-125mg-po-bid-asplenia)

< OR >

[Cefuroxime 500MG PO BID for asplenia empiric antibiotic \($\) R](psozid-cefuroxime-500mg-po-bid-asplenia)
